metrics.definition: Share of delivered sales order lines that arrived on or before the date we committed to the customer.
metrics.denominator: Delivered, non-cancelled lines with actual_delivery_date in the period.
metrics.formula_text: SUM(is_on_time) / SUM(is_delivered), lines dated by actual_delivery_date, cancelled lines excluded from both.
metrics.name: on_time_delivery
metrics.title: On-time delivery

ledger.sql:
SELECT * FROM SEMANTIC_VIEW(
    EXECUTIVE_SV_V1
    METRICS delivered_lines.on_time_delivery
    WHERE delivered_lines.period_month BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2026-09-01'
)
